main_text.p: Nouatiani qui pœnitentiam, nunc Æriani qui oblationes pro mortuis & ieiunia; Iouinianistæ qui fidem lubricam & euanidam, Vigilantiani qui reliquiarum adorationem, Nestoriani qui afferuatiouem panis Eucharistici, Xenaitæ qui imagines, Lampetiani qui votorum seruitutem. Parum hercle refert Timotheum ne Presbyterum, an Athanasium incusçt fœdum os meretriculæ; Certum est illud Nazianzeni, Hier. ad Theop. aduersus. Ier. 10. Etenim bonos carpere malorum solatium est, (vere Hieronymus.) Quod ergo Lindijs olim solenne erat sacra non

page.notes: Greek words in the text ("ἐὰν τὰς ψυχὰς τῆς γλώσσης εὐτρεπίζειν") are partly illegible in the scan. The marginal notes on the right are small and partly blurred; their readings are approximate. The lower right note "Hieros. ad. Hierosol." is uncertain.
